subject: Welcome to NABARUN — Please set your password to access your account

header.heading: Welcome{{#if title}}, {{title}}{{/if}}
header.subHeading: We are delighted to have you on board

content.paragraph1_blue: It is our pleasure to have you on board. An account has been prepared for you, and you may sign in using the email address {{email}}.
content.paragraph2_blue: To complete your registration, please set a personal password{{#if setPasswordUrl}} by following this secure link: {{setPasswordUrl}}. Completing this step will also verify your email address{{else}}. Kindly open the application, select "Forgot password", and enter {{email}} to receive a secure set-password link{{/if}}.
content.paragraph3_blue: Once your password has been set, please open the application and sign in with {{email}} and the password you have chosen.
content.paragraph4_blue: Should the link expire or prove inaccessible, you may use "Forgot password" on the sign-in page, or contact your administrator for assistance. We look forward to supporting you.
